Use case: identity-preserve. Draw ONE new production animation frame of this exact chibi moon-shadow assassin girl, facing RIGHT/E in full-body side view.
Image 1 definitive character identity. Image 2 E idle establishes exact camera, head-to-body scale and right side costume. Image 3 PRIMARY approved art STYLE only, match bright clean rounded high-definition Chinese Daoist hand-painted rendering; do not draw UI.
Preserve silver-lavender bob with one cowlick, large violet eyes, navy-gold short coat and scarf, ivory sleeves, loose navy trousers and crescent boots, silver crescent belt with turquoise beads. Exactly TWO crescent daggers with silver blades, gold guards and turquoise centers, ONE gripped by EACH hand. Show continuous shoulder-elbow-wrist-hand chains, thumbs and fingers firmly around handles. Left temple three-petal navy moon ornament is FAR SIDE for E, hidden by bob except a tiny gold tip. No ornament on near right temple.
HIT E frame 03 of 06: maximal recoil from an unseen impact arriving from screen RIGHT. Torso and head lean backward LEFT about 20 degrees, chin raised a little, eyes squeezed in brief pain, mouth small open. Near anatomical RIGHT boot planted slightly forward/right and knee bent to absorb impact; far LEFT boot takes a backward step screen-left, toe touches virtual ground. Keep TWO distinct bent legs, no twisted knee. Near RIGHT elbow retracts beside waist, right dagger held low ahead of hip and blade clear of leg. Far LEFT arm opens slightly backward away from torso, still grips second dagger; both daggers visible and never contact body. Scarf lags forward/right with recoil. No attacker or injury.
Fixed orthographic camera matching E idle, fixed proportions. Single square canvas at least 1024x1024 native, full body with margins, consistent virtual root at x50%, ground plane at y92%; pose changes but no crop or independent bounding-box fitting. Real transparent RGBA, clean alpha edges. No ground shadow, text, framing, motion trails, spell effects, particles or glow. Highest visual finish. Project target GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst / max; actual model/quality host-managed without selectors.
